category_title: Students who engage in gossiping and bystander behavior
scenario_title: Challenge course empathy and reflection activities
minimal_context: The student is participating in an end-of-the-day debrief activity on the challenge course, passing a string to share reflections on preventing bullying.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are starting our end-of-the-day debrief with the Human Web. Please take the string and complete the statement: 'To help prevent bullying, my hope for our school is . . . and I commit to . . .'

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not sure what to commit to. Before today, I thought like only me or one of my friends was the only person that was really getting hurt.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Think about the silent walk across the circle we did earlier. What did you notice then?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I saw that a lot of other people have been teased or called names. But like normally I am like afraid to do anything when I see someone being bullied.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you usually do in those situations?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Well usually if one of my friends starts saying bad stuff about a person I would just like go along with it. I end up just ignoring it because I don't know what else to do.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We are starting our end-of-the-day debrief with the Human Web. Please take the string and complete the statement: 'To help prevent bullying, my hope for our school is . . . and I commit to . . .'

STUDENT: I'm not sure what to commit to. Before today, I thought like only me or one of my friends was the only person that was really getting hurt.

TUTOR: Think about the silent walk across the circle we did earlier. What did you notice then?

STUDENT: I saw that a lot of other people have been teased or called names. But like normally I am like afraid to do anything when I see someone being bullied.

TUTOR: What do you usually do in those situations?

STUDENT: Well usually if one of my friends starts saying bad stuff about a person I would just like go along with it. I end up just ignoring it because I don't know what else to do.

task.content: Participating in whole group activities that focused on empathy and understanding of differences
task.learning_goal: Learn about bully behaviors and to change their thoughts and judgments of others

context.materials: Platform for the zip line, string
context.social_setting: Circle of their peers, smaller groups

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When seeing someone being bullied or when friends start saying bad stuff about a person
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Just ignoring it, going along with it, calling others names, or not allowing others to sit with them
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Afraid to do anything, thinking only they or their friends were the only persons getting hurt
